  P.player_name, 
  (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', P.birthday)) - 
  (strftime('%m-%d', 'now') < strftime('%m-%d', P.birthday)) AS age
FROM 
  Player P
JOIN 
  Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE 
  PA.sprint_speed >= 97

    (CAST((T1.fastestLapSpeed - T2.fastestLapSpeed) AS REAL) / T2.fastestLapSpeed) * 100 AS percentage_faster
FROM 
    results AS T1
JOIN 
    results AS T2
ON 
    T1.driverId = T2.driverId
WHERE 
    T1.driverId = (SELECT driverId FROM drivers WHERE forename = 'Paul' AND surname = 'di Resta')
    AND T1.raceId = 853
    AND T2.raceId = 854
